<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
A critical bug was found in a dictionary definition.

The dictionary uses integer keys, which Hugo rejects. This would crash the build for any post with `level_depth` in its frontmatter. However, the Cloudflare logs show the build hanging for over eight minutes after "Start building sites," not crashing. The delay likely comes from rendering the notes export first, which is expensive. The `level_depth` error may be a separate failure that simply hasn't reached the site build step yet.

The commit included a 2224-line `.specstory/history` file. This should not affect Hugo, since specstory is typically gitignored. The clone completed quickly, so the delay is elsewhere. The next steps are fixing the dictionary key bug and profiling the notes build.

Several bottlenecks were identified. The `related-notes.html` partial is not cached when called from `toc-related-extras`, forcing a regex scan across all notes for every blog post. Other suspects include `--forceSyncStatic` on a 237MB public folder, image processing, and low `GOMAXPROCS` on Cloudflare. A timed production build with `GOMAXPROCS=1` will simulate the Cloudflare environment. The notes single template cost also needs measurement.

The related-notes partial runs an O(notes × aliases × regex) scan for every blog post. A build deadlock between minify and forceSyncStatic is also suspected. The plan is to fix the dictionary keys to strings, cache the partial, and profile the build.
</details></think>

The build slowdown likely stems from `self-hosted-fonts.html` calling `resources`.

Local testing confirmed that `GetRemote` to Google Fonts hangs indefinitely in a sandbox without network access. On Cloudflare Pages, network access is available, so the eight-minute delay must stem from a different bottleneck.

The eight-minute hang is unlikely to be normal for Cloudflare's free tier, where builds typically finish in two to four minutes. Local builds take about thirty-five seconds. The real culprit is probably a dictionary error or another severe bottleneck, not just slow network requests.
